related_questions.question: Do I need proof of vaccination to travel to Mexico?
related_questions.snippet: The short answer is no – Mexico does not require proof of COVID-19 vaccination for entry. Unlike many countries, there are no testing or quarantine requirements, regardless of vaccination status. However, staying up to date with your COVID-19 vaccines is still highly recommended for your own health and safety.
